senses.gloss: f. (גדר) partition; ג׳ דקני (= h. חיצת קנים) a hedge of reeds spreading from a common stem.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 50b">Sabb. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>בגורד׳ דקני</he> ed. (corr. <he>בגודר׳</he>, Ms. M. <he>בגרירתא</he>, corr. <he>בגדיר׳</he>; Ar. <he>בי גזרתא</he>) (to put a knife) between the branches of a hedge of reeds. [The vers. of Ar. proves <he>גודר׳</he> to be the proper version and <he>גורד׳</he> or <he>גריר׳</he>, corruptions.]
